entries.name: frame_map_scroll_iwram
entries.evidence: Matching installer 0x08039e78 publishes destination 0x03005e60 to callback word 0x03001fcc; source/destination/control literals establish 228-byte copy. The first 216 bytes are matching C frame_transfer_map_tiles at the RAM execution address; copied following ARM prefix remains unconverted. View argument is narrowed to a byte; allowed indices remain unresolved.

entries.name: audio_sample_active_ram
entries.evidence: Copied audio image from startup installs ROM 0xFDAA40 at RAM 0x030005C8. Standalone instrument starter loads this ARM address and calls it through r7. The complete 56-byte handle/activity check including its pool matches C at the RAM execution address; the following four-byte counter storage remains explicit data.

limitations: Static original-image map; no runtime trace or complete code/data partition.
Not every byte within a copy or between entries is executable.
Self-modifying instruction state differs after execution; keep original and runtime state distinct.
No executable entry found in initial EWRAM copy; later code installation remains possible.
Audio function names are reconstructed, some intentionally address-based.
